missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Позиция' is feminine nominative as the subject. 'Понятна' is the short-form adjective agreeing in the feminine, with 'очень' intensifying.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Позицию' is the feminine accusative object of 'понимаю'. 'Твою' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В позиции' uses the prepositional ending after 'в' to describe the situation. 'Сильной' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Позиции' is genitive after 'нет', and 'чёткой' agrees in the feminine genitive. The frame shows he lacks a clear stance.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'От позиции' takes the genitive after 'от' to mean abandoning the position. 'Своей' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'На позицию' uses the accusative after 'на' to show moving into the position. 'Защитника' is genitive meaning of the defender.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Благодаря позиции' uses the dative after 'благодаря' to mean thanks to the position. 'Команда' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Позицией' is the instrumental required by 'доволен' to mean satisfied with the position. 'Своей' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Позиции' is the accusative plural object of 'заняли'. 'Свои' agrees in the plural, and 'игроки' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Позиций' is the genitive plural required after 'несколько'. 'Разных' agrees in the genitive plural.
